narrative_purpose: The chapter's representative plate for the landing book-map: one native body at rest inside air thick enough to see, its ear membrane lit from within so the vessels read as plumbing rather than ornament. The whole chapter is that pairing - breathing this atmosphere, and dumping the heat of living in it.
subject: A tight three-quarter portrait of a single tall blue-skinned humanoid head, neck and one shoulder, filling most of the frame. Eyes closed, jaw relaxed, chest just visible at the lower edge mid-inhalation. The near ear is held out wide and away from the skull and is backlit so a fine branching network of vessels shows clearly through its thin membrane. Fine condensation beads along the cheekbone and the ridge of the ear. No mask, no equipment, nothing over the face. Dense luminous spore motes hang suspended in the air immediately around the head, thick enough that the air itself reads as a substance rather than emptiness.
scene: Deep in a bioluminescent forest at close range, the background nothing but layered glowing haze and suspended particulate, no trunks or landmarks resolved.
camera: Close three-quarter portrait, shallow apparent depth, the head and the held-out ear filling the frame.
light: Cool bioluminescent key from below and behind, rim-lighting the ear membrane so its vessels glow through it; a scarce warm ember bleed from inside the ear itself; the face mostly in soft indigo shadow.
palette: Void-indigo ground, cyan and living-teal in the suspended spore field and along the skin edges, a single scarce ember-amber warmth glowing through the ear membrane.
style: Painterly naturalist portrait plate, hand-painted texture, observed rather than posed, confident single-subject focal hierarchy.
detail_level: Crisp on the vessel tracery in the backlit ear, on the condensation beads, and on the nearest suspended spores; the face softer; the background entirely dissolved into glowing haze.
composition: Single head filling the left two thirds with the backlit ear on the focal line, dense glowing haze occupying the right third as quiet negative space.
consistency_notes: Cool Pandora palette with bioluminescent key from the surrounding air. The subject is tall and slender with large eyes and long pointed mobile ears; strictly one figure, no human and no breathing apparatus anywhere in frame. The warm glow appears only inside the ear membrane, nowhere else.
negative_prompt: no text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no diagram labels, no arrows, no breathing mask, no respirator, no second figure, no photographic or 3D-render look, no lens flares, no cartoon or anime style
